Configures the metrics that this component generates to monitor its state.

region.description: AWS region to collect logs from.

imds_endpoint.description: Custom EC2 IMDS endpoint to use.

storage.description: Handler from an otelcol.storage component to use for persisting state.

output.description: Configures where to send received telemetry data.

arguments.name: logs
arguments.description: List of consumers to send logs to.

arguments.name: metrics
arguments.description: List of consumers to send metrics to.

arguments.name: traces
arguments.description: List of consumers to send traces to.

debug_metrics.description: Configures the metrics that this component generates to monitor its state.

arguments.name: max_events_per_request
arguments.description: Maximum number of events to process per request to CloudWatch.

arguments.name: poll_interval
arguments.description: How frequently to poll for new log entries.

arguments.name: start_from
arguments.description: Timestamp in RFC3339 format where to start reading logs.

arguments.name: groups
arguments.type: Configures which log groups to collect from.

arguments.name: autodiscover
arguments.type: Configures automatic discovery of log groups.

arguments.name: named
arguments.type: Configures specific log groups to collect from.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: Maximum number of log groups to discover.

arguments.name: prefix
arguments.description: Prefix to filter log groups by.

arguments.name: names
arguments.description: List of exact stream names to collect.

arguments.name: prefixes
arguments.description: List of prefixes to filter streams by.
